title: LDA helpers share one positional class encoding
answers: What targets do LDA class statistics helpers accept?
How do LDA means and covariances stay aligned with classes and priors?
How can LDA avoid repeatedly computing unique labels?
body:
Invariant: Computational targets are integer codes indexing classes_; class means, covariance weights, and SVD groups must use that same positional mapping.
Mechanism: sklearn/discriminant_analysis.py:LinearDiscriminantAnalysis.fit encodes once; the solvers pass classes_.shape[0] as n_classes to _class_means and _class_cov.
Enforcement: sklearn/discriminant_analysis.py:_class_means, sklearn/discriminant_analysis.py:_class_cov, and sklearn/discriminant_analysis.py:LinearDiscriminantAnalysis._solve_svd group samples by integer positions.
Constraints: Helper callers must supply encoded targets and the matching class count. Passing arbitrary raw labels breaks positional grouping; helpers should not recompute unique labels from the target.
applies: Changes to LDA solver plumbing or shared class-statistics helpers in discriminant_analysis.py.
